lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 7 to 8 visible vertical white line segments; spacing is wider in the mid-torso region and narrower toward the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed at the dorsal terminus of the third major line from the shoulder where it splits toward the mane.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line 1 (anterior) terminates before reaching the mid-section; Line 6 is fragmented and does not reach the ventral line.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Single high-contrast spot on the upper posterior haunch; secondary faint cluster of three small spots located near the rear leg junction.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate and spiraled silhouette; outward and posterior trajectory with a lateral twist (~45-degree angle from the skull base).
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: Estimated pixel distance between horn tips is approximately 2.1 times the width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping occupies approximately 10-15% of the total visible horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Three distinct white spots on the facial region (two below the eye, one on the cheek); white chevron on the snout; white patches on lower limbs.
